customer_name: Shijingshan District Large Model Industry Innovation Base
business_problem: Shijingshan District wanted to attract AI companies, help local enterprises adopt large-model technology, and build a practical public-service environment for tools, talent, and innovation instead of leaving firms to solve AI adoption independently.
solution_summary: Shijingshan District and Baidu AI Cloud built an innovation base for the Qianfan large-model ecosystem using a 'one base, three engines' operating model. The base is designed as a public platform for enterprise upgrading, scenario incubation, and talent development rather than a single application. Qianfan ModelBuilder and Qianfan AppBuilder give local developers and companies access to core large-model tools, while Baidu's ecosystem support adds forums, incubation programs, and enterprise co-creation around AI-native applications. The three 'engines' cover public general-AI services, talent development, and industrial enablement, so the district can support both technical adoption and ecosystem growth. In practice, the base works as a regional AI layer that brings together tool access, training, demonstrations, and partner matchmaking across verticals such as manufacturing, education, healthcare, energy, transportation, finance, cultural tourism, and urban management.
products_used: Qianfan Large Model Industry Innovation Base

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Industry Innovation Base

data_flow: Local enterprises and developers access the Qianfan base for model tooling and application building, then feed resulting pilots and AI-native services into district incubation, forums, and industry demonstrations. Talent programs and enterprise co-creation activities in turn expand the pool of users and scenarios using the platform.
business_outcome: Shijingshan established a public large-model base that helps enterprises adopt AI faster, strengthens local talent supply, and makes the district more attractive as an AI industry cluster.
metrics: The district planned 4 high-quality forums or exchange events each year.
architecture_clues: The operating model is described as one base plus three engines
The district uses Qianfan to co-create AI-native applications with local enterprises
The base combines tool access, incubation, events, and talent training in one regional service layer
evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud and Shijingshan built the first Qianfan large-model industry innovation base in the country through a 'one base, three engines' approach (original: 百度智能云与石景山区共建千帆大模型产业创新基地，通过"一基地三引擎"模式打造AI产业生态).

The base includes a large-model technical platform, scenario incubation, enterprise attraction and incubation, and talent cultivation (original: 该基地围绕建设运营服务展开，包括搭建大模型技术平台、孵化运营平台场景，引进与孵化科技企业，以及引进与培育人才等).

The public-service engine gives developers deep-learning and large-model toolsets, while the talent engine trains local AI talent and the industry engine connects AI technology with industrial development (original: 将发挥通用人工智能公共服务引擎…为开发者提供深度学习及大模型工具集…构建人工智能人才引擎…将建立通用人工智能产业引擎).

The district planned to use the base to drive intelligent upgrades in manufacturing, education, healthcare, energy, transport, finance, cultural tourism, and urban management (original: 在制造、教育、医疗、能源、交通、金融、文旅和城市管理等垂直行业领域，依托百度平台带动传统产业进行智能化改造升级).
